pending.body: In nitrogen_cycle.rs after the comammox budget deduction (around line 352), `alk_budget` is left stale at its pre-comammox value because the recent refactor replaced `alk_budget = (alk_budget - comammox_alk_cost).max(0.0)` with a local `let remaining_alk_budget`. Add `alk_budget = remaining_alk_budget.max(0.0);` after the debug_assert (or shadow `alk_budget` with `let alk_budget = ...`) to maintain the running-budget invariant. Without this, any future guild step added after comammox but before the final alkalinity commit at line 434 would silently read an inflated budget and over-allocate alkalinity.

The constant MG_N_PER_MEQ_AMMONIA (= 14.007) is defined identically in both microfauna.rs:9 and shrimp.rs:9 for ammonia excretion alkalinity coupling. Centralize it in process.rs alongside NITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N and DENITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N, since all three derive from the atomic mass of nitrogen and govern alkalinity stoichiometry. This prevents future divergence if one copy is changed without the other.
